mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM password_reset_requests WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_requests SET invalidated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND used_at IS NULL AND invalidated_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT request_id AS requestId,code_hash AS codeHash,attempts FROM password_reset_requests WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND verified_at IS NULL AND invalidated_at IS NULL AND used_at IS NULL AND code_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY request_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_requests SET attempts=attempts+1 WHERE request_id=#{requestId}
UPDATE password_reset_requests SET invalidated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND invalidated_at IS NULL

UPDATE password_reset_requests SET verified_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,reset_token_hash=#{tokenHash}, reset_token_expires_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{tokenMinutes} MINUTE) WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND verified_at IS NULL AND invalidated_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT request_id AS requestId,user_id AS userId FROM password_reset_requests WHERE reset_token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND used_at IS NULL AND invalidated_at IS NULL AND reset_token_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_requests SET used_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND used_at IS NULL
